assessment.report:
# Documentation governance: scoped repository adoption

Task: Implement documentation governance 0.9.0.

## Assessment and timing

This is the retrospective close/adoption assessment for the new governance capability itself. Before its runtime existed, the Lead reviewed the approved user decisions, current source structure and shared contracts, then validated the stage packet before delegating implementation. No preimplementation runtime pass is claimed. Documentation is sufficient for this bounded capability; this is not whole-project readiness, a release approval, a stable promotion or human acceptance.

## Sources and authority

No applicable product PRD or OpenSpec opt-in marker exists in this repository. The user's confirmed decisions authorize the task: optional task-specific document categories, docs/PRD authority when present, existing-project adoption, docs/legacy only after confirmed suitability, and questions before substantive ambiguous changes. The shared governance contract implements that intent. docs/architecture.md records the existing and new module boundaries; no structural refactor is necessary or authorized.

README, architecture, release policy, deployment guide, attribution notes and the current stage packet were read. Other-capability verification was inspected for scope only, not fully re-certified. Dated designs/plans are outside the feature-specific assessment and are not claimed reread, historical, obsolete or eligible for archival. They remain untouched. No document or directory is moved merely for adoption; no empty PRD or legacy folder is created.

## Sufficiency

Requirements and non-goals are confirmed in the user decisions/shared contract. Architecture and owned files are mapped. CLI, authored review/state schemas, selected dependencies and fail-closed path/freshness rules are documented. No rendered UI is changed. PowerShell 7 and isolated test commands are reproducible. The stage packet owns coverage, actual automated outcomes and manual checks. No new package/service dependency or migration of a prior governance schema is required.

## Findings and limits

No unresolved requirement or authority ambiguity blocks this scope. Independent review findings on unavailable unrelated material and changed dependency shape were corrected and regression-checked; exact outcomes are in the stage packet. Semantic adequacy and user approval authenticity cannot be proven by hashes. Large-repository performance, live agent quality and interruption recovery are not certified. Manual acceptance remains pending; an automated ready record must never replace that state.

## Continued development

Validate this exact scope/task before reuse. Changed documents, classification/authority, selected source dependencies or checking policy require impact assessment and a fresh review. New tasks need their own scoped assessment. Stop affected work and ask the user if future documents introduce ambiguous intent or precedence. Kit provenance is recorded separately from policy/schema; do not refresh fingerprints solely to pass.
